name: Thermal Engineering II
topics: Reciprocating Air Compressors
Explain the effect of clearance volume on the work of a reciprocating compressor.
Derive the work for isothermal, adiabatic and polytropic compression; explain two-stage/multistage compression with intercooling.
Centrifugal Compressors
Explain the working of a centrifugal compressor and the pressure/velocity variation in impeller and diffuser.
Draw the velocity triangles and find the impeller work; explain surging, choking, static and total head.
IC Engines: Cycles, Valve Timing and Indicator Diagrams
Draw the actual valve timing and p–V diagrams of a four-stroke petrol engine; explain the four-stroke diesel engine.
Why is a four-stroke engine more efficient than a two-stroke? Compare efficiencies at different compression ratios; find the clearance ratio for the given data.
Combustion and Ignition Systems
Explain pre-ignition, detonation and knocking.
Explain the coil/battery ignition system of an SI engine.
Gas Turbines and Brayton Cycle
Find the work ratio and thermal efficiency of the given open-cycle gas turbine.
Explain regeneration and reheating effects and open vs closed gas turbines.
Jet Propulsion
Explain turbojet and ramjet engines with diagrams.
Compare their applications.
Compressible Flow
Find the stagnation pressure for the given air flow.
Explain Mach number, Mach wave, Mach cone and angle; discuss the continuity equation for compressible flow.
